images.name: home-hero-v2
images.intent: 멈춘 일반 보드게임 판을 남기고 다시 돌아오는 분위기
images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Style/medium: slightly anime-inspired casual board-game illustration, stylized 2D, hand-drawn clean contours, rounded shapes, gentle cel shading, lively but restrained, collectible game-art character appeal. Soft dark navy contours, shallow paper texture and soft 2D shadows. World: a generic board-game tabletop. Palette: blue #3978BD and coral #E56B5D pawns, honey #E3B750 markers, calm green #68A68B, cream #FFF7E6 cards. Game pieces should feel rounded with a little character appeal, without faces or exaggerated personification. No humans, logos, boxes with branding, words, text, watermarks, sparkles, purple neon, glossy 3D, realistic materials or famous game layouts. No hexagonal island, harbor, famous card illustrations, property perimeter or recognizable castle-wall patterns. One original scene, no collage, no UI, no split screen.
Scene: A paused general board game on a quiet table, an original square folding board with a simple branching path and a few plain circular spaces, two ivory dice, a small cream card stack and two loose cards with simple geometric motifs, several blue and coral wooden pawns and a few honey circular tokens. A plain unbranded open storage box sits at the outer edge. Readable complete board centered as the clear visual anchor with breathing room around it. Mood: a pleasant game paused mid-session, ready to preserve and return to later. Wide 3:2 composition, slightly elevated overhead illustrated viewpoint, all major board edges visible. Rich authored 2D game art, not a minimal icon.
